## Requirements (§5i.1)

1. `fleet.open` activation — `RunKind::Fleet` run, durable FleetSpec
   (`lifecycle.fleet.activated` + manifest extras: `narrowing_leaves`,
   `policy_ref`, `budget`/`budget_ref`, `purpose = fleet_activation`),
   `stale_spec` written before any item can dispatch.
2. `fleet.observe` — durable `context.observation.recorded{trigger, item}`
   + `control.wakeup.occurred{external|manual}` (fleet-boundary admissibility
   only; all other trigger kinds still refuse typed).
3. `fleet.reconcile` — RC-1…8 level-triggered, idempotent (durable cursor +
   O(1) skips), over the fixture `WorkSourceAdapter`.
4. `fleet.admit` — durable `control.work_item.dispatched` (state = `queued`);
   `idempotency_key` dedup (`known` / `conflict` mismatch → `SourceConflict`).
5. `fleet.dispatch_note` — `dispatch.run_ref`/`dispatch.error` on the durable row.
6. Ownership — `fleet.set_owner` (cross-fleet, cycles, unknown → typed refusals),
   `fleet.ack_owner` (durable, reviewer/`local_admin` not required),
   `fleet.handoff` (atomic `handoff` + `owner_changed`; current owner or
   `local_admin` only).
7. Escalation — `fleet.escalate` → `lifecycle.escalation.raised`
   (+ `control.work_item.blocked{escalation}` + `timer` wakeup for
   `deadline_ms`), `fleet.resolve_escalation` → `resolved` + unblock;
   `legitimate` rule (`Refused{illegitimate_resolution}`);
   `resolution_count`.
8. `fleet.settle` — `Outcome` + `evidence_refs`; preconditions (rc1/rc5
   re-check at settle).
9. `fleet.block`/`fleet.unblock`/`fleet.stop`.
10. Reads — `fleet.work_item`, `fleet.list`, `fleet.state_map` (Π leaves +
    `narrowing` delta), `fleet.accountability_record` (Rule-O links).
11. Matched-budget conditional — RC-6 `dispatch.declared`, `blocked{budget}`,
    `external_effect_account`, `matched`, missing `budget_ref` refusal.
12. `check_activation_delta` — `narrowing`/`widening` over `policy_delta`.
13. Restore — `ensure` restores from the durable prefix only; crash/replay
    equivalence at every decision point.
14. Removability — `hh-fleet` edge-free upward; `hh-embed` carries it under
    the optional `tier-c4` feature (absent ⇒ `Refused{stage_pending}`);
    no other workspace crate depends on it.

## Deviations & owned decisions (for the PR + ADR notes)

- **`control.work_item.created` vs `dispatched{verb:admit}`** — the §5i.1
  record vocabulary names `created`; earlier slices emitted the admit via
  the `dispatched` verb row. Both classes are declared; the engine emits
  `created` as the canonical admission row. The `dispatched{verb:admit}`
  spelling is retained in the dialect for back-compat (CC8 — additive).
- **RC numbering** — the canonical RC-1…8 invariants (§5i.1 "Invariants")
  are implemented as *folded gates* inside `reconcile`'s ordered pass
  (observe→conflicts→admits→source-updates→suspensions→stalls/retry→
  children→dispatches→escalation-deadlines). Engine-internal step labels
  (RC-2 lease, RC-5 stall, RC-6 capacity…) predate the §5i.1 numbering;
  the canonical mapping is recorded in the PR table. Canonical **RC-5**
  (`unowned_dispatch_count` veto) lands as `OwnerRequired`/`OwnerAckRequired`
  refusals + `dispatch_candidate`'s owner gate; **RC-7** (fan_out bound) is
  the `capacity.activate_run` durable-data bound (skip-not-trim).
- **`handoff` vocabulary** — `control.work_item.handoff` is the
  canonical state-handoff record, kernel-produced only: the escalation
  `to_agent` arm and the overdue resolved-owner takeover mint it,
  carrying the `lease_agent` surrogate, re-assigning ownership and
  folding the item to state `handoff`. `fleet.transfer_owner` is the
  canonical O-4 two-event handshake — `control.work_item.
  owner_changed{from, to, basis}` (`basis ∈ {approval, policy_rule}`,
  enforced at the op) then `owner_acknowledged{by = to}` — emitting no
  `handoff` row and no graph edge. The fleet-boundary/source human-gate
  entry is `blocked{human_gate}` (the fleet dialect's typed cause),
  folded by `derive_state` to the canonical `handoff` state and exited
  only by `resume_from_handoff`'s durable ack.
- **Legitimate resolution** — `resolve_escalation` requires `by ∈
  {escalation.to_agent, item resolved-owner chain, local_admin}` and
  `resolution` is the canonical E-5 closed set `{acknowledged, amended,
  reassigned, cancelled, expired}` — the grant model pending D-1's
  directory (ApproverGrants/EscalationTargets per ADR-0211).
- **Trigger admissibility layering** — the LEDGER admits kernel-admissible
  triggers plus fleet-boundary `external`/`manual` on `run_kind = fleet`
  runs (manifest-checked); the FLEET SPEC layer restricts declarable
  trigger rules to `external`/`manual`/`timer` (`UnsupportedTrigger` typed
  refusal at `open`). `peer_message` is kernel-admissible (S4.6) but is
  refused as a fleet trigger rule.
- **`activate_run` capacity** — a full pool leaves items queued (durable
  data bound), matching RC-7's "refuse the next dispatch, never trim".
- **Budget** — matched arm: `spec.budget` root + per-dispatch `Slice`
  allocation recorded as `dispatch.declared`; `MissingBudgetRef` covers
  the third conditional cell; `UnbudgetedArm`/`InsufficientBudget` map
  onto the closed `EmbedError` sum.
- **Restore equality** — provenance rows legitimately advance the folded
  prefix on takeover (`lifecycle.lease.{fenced,acquired}`); the rebuild-
  equality assertion compares all state members, `derived_from` is the
  declared watermark.
